items.q: Boy develops torticollis and oculogyric crisis two days after haloperidol. Treatment is what?
o: Anticholinergic such as procyclidine (or benztropine) promptly
items.exp: Acute dystonia is early EPS emergency (airway threatening if laryngeal) reversed by parenteral anticholinergic, then regimen review. Continuing culprit worsens it.
r: Incorrect. More blockade worsens dystonia.
Correct. Anticholinergic reverses acute dystonia.
Incorrect. Beta blockers suit akathisia.
Incorrect. ECT not first for dystonia.
items.kp: Twisted neck day two: procyclidine now.

items.q: Inner restlessness, pacing, inability to sit still two weeks on antipsychotic, often misread as agitation, is what and needs what?
o: Akathisia; dose reduction or switch, beta blocker or benzodiazepine adjuncts
items.exp: Akathisia is subjective motor restlessness linked to distress and suicide; raising antipsychotic for apparent agitation worsens trap. Reduce or switch culprit, propranolol or short benzodiazepine or mirtazapine strategies by guidance.
r: Incorrect. Tardive is late choreiform, not restlessness.
Correct. Akathisia, reduce dopamine blockade burden.
Incorrect. No elevated mood syndrome described.
Incorrect. Catatonia is immobility spectrum opposite.
items.kp: Cannot sit inside own skin: akathisia.

items.q: Fever 39.5, lead pipe rigidity, confusion, CK 8000, one week after antipsychotic increase. Diagnosis and first step?
o: Neuroleptic malignant syndrome; stop antipsychotic, urgent medical ICU care
items.exp: NMS follows dopamine blockade with hyperthermia, rigidity, delirium, dysautonomia and muscle breakdown; immediate cessation, cooling, fluids and critical care, considering dantrolene, bromocriptine or ECT refractory. Sepsis workup parallels but drug stop cannot wait.
r: Incorrect. Serotonin has clonus and serotonergic exposure.
Correct. NMS: stop antipsychotic, ICU.
Incorrect. More blockade kills.
Incorrect. Infection may coexist but NMS action is urgent.
items.kp: Hot, rigid, confused on antipsychotic: stop it.

items.q: Serotonin syndrome is separated from NMS most by which signs?
o: Clonus, hyperreflexia, agitation and diarrhoea after serotonergic agents
items.exp: Serotonergic excess gives neuromuscular hyperactivity (spontaneous or inducible clonus, hyperreflexia lower limbs) with hyperactive bowels, versus NMS hyporeflexic lead pipe rigidity after dopamine blockers. Both fever and confuse.
r: Incorrect. Both can fever high.
Correct. Clonus and hyperreflexia mean serotonin.
Incorrect. That describes NMS.
Incorrect. CK rises in both severe cases.
items.kp: Clonus points serotonin; lead pipe points NMS.

items.q: Which antipsychotics carry greatest weight gain and diabetes risk as pair?
items.exp: Metabolic hierarchy places clozapine and olanzapine worst, risperidone and quetiapine intermediate, aripiprazole and ziprasidone or lurasidone patterns lower, guiding choice in obesity and diabetes risk with monitoring regardless.
r: Incorrect. Those are metabolically kinder.
Correct. Clozapine and olanzapine worst.
Incorrect. Typicals burden movement more than metabolism.
Incorrect. Quetiapine is intermediate, not lowest.

items.q: Amenorrhoea, galactorrhoea and sexual dysfunction on risperidone reflect which effect and pathway?
items.exp: Dopamine tonically inhibits prolactin; pituitary blockade raises it (risperidone, amisulpride, typicals highest; aripiprazole lowers), causing hypogonadism and bone loss needing level check and switch planning.
r: Incorrect. QT is cardiac conduction issue.
Correct. Prolactin rise from D2 blockade.
Incorrect. Dryness differs from galactorrhoea.
Incorrect. No serotonergic storm pattern.
items.kp: Milky, period stopped on risperidone: prolactin.

items.q: Tardive dyskinesia management first steps are what?
o: Review and reduce or switch culprit antipsychotic, consider VMAT2 inhibitor for persistent impairing movements
items.exp: Anticholinergics worsen tardive dyskinesia; dose minimisation or clozapine switch and vesicular monoamine transporter inhibitors (valbenazine class where available) treat established cases, with prevention by lowest effective dose and AIMS monitoring.
r: Incorrect. Anticholinergics aggravate TD.
Correct. Reduce culprit, VMAT2 inhibitor option.
Incorrect. Masking raises dose and worsens course.
Incorrect. Sedation not disease treatment.
items.kp: Late mouth movements: less blocker, not anticholinergic.

items.q: Clozapine early treatment vigilance beyond neutropenia must include which two lethal risks?
o: Myocarditis (first weeks) and severe constipation ileus
items.exp: Fever, chest pain, tachycardia in first months raise myocarditis needing CRP troponin pathways, while clozapine constipation kills via ileus requiring active bowel questioning and laxatives at every contact.
r: Incorrect. Skin issues minor beside these.
Correct. Myocarditis and ileus constipation.
Incorrect. Not clozapine signature.
Incorrect. Retina concerns vigabatrin or phenothiazine history.
items.kp: Clozapine kills by heart inflammation and blocked bowel too.

items.q: Aripiprazole differs mechanistically as what, giving which advantages?
o: Dopamine partial agonist; low metabolic and prolactin lowering, but akathisia and impulse control warnings
items.exp: Partial agonism stabilises dopamine (antipsychotic with less hyperprolactinaemia and metabolic burden) at cost of activation, akathisia, nausea and rare impulse control disorders (gambling) counselling.
r: Incorrect. It activates partially, less sedating.
Correct. Partial agonist profile.
Incorrect. D2 action is core.
Incorrect. Binding is reversible.
items.kp: Half on dopamine: kinder metabolism, restless edge.

items.q: High dose antipsychotic polypharmacy default guideline stance is what?
o: Avoid; document exceptional rationale, ECG and monitoring if ever used, taper to monotherapy
items.exp: Combinations raise QT, metabolic and movement harm without general efficacy gain (clozapine augmentation exceptions specialist led); guidelines demand monotherapy optimisation and clozapine for resistance instead.
r: Incorrect. Opposite of guidance.
Correct. Avoid polypharmacy, monotherapy and clozapine pathway.
Incorrect. First episode needs low dose single agent.
Incorrect. Polypharmacy delays proven clozapine.
items.kp: One antipsychotic well used beats three stacked.
